CLM-MAT-0451.statement: Phono3GPU on the RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell achieves total wall times that are 2 to 6 times shorter compared to a GPU plug-in for phono3py.

extra_quotes: Phono3GPU is implemented in PyTorch [20], accepts force constants in phono3py format, and generates output files compatible with phono3py.
